latest_correction.defect: The V2 flattened subset comparison missed a conflicting current record when both records shared an asset but each carried a different compatible extra qualifier.
latest_correction.fix: Use canonical typed secondary identities. A conflict requires at least one matching shared type and no disagreement on shared types. Non-overlapping extra qualifiers do not conceal the shared identity. Unrelated types with the same spelling do not prove identity.
latest_correction.selected_root_rule: Every value-side secondary identifier must have an exact same-type binding in the selected primary-product root. Part Number/Part No/PN aliases are canonicalized; contradictory aliases cannot establish one identity.

fixture_correction_disclosure.issue: The Part Number variants of the authored long-record fixture declared only Asset in the root, so the purported explicit typed relationship was absent.
fixture_correction_disclosure.corrected_positive: The positive fixture now explicitly declares Part Number in the root for those variants.
fixture_correction_disclosure.preserved_originals: Four original mismatched-type long-record layouts remain as rejection controls in test_unified_mismatched_types.py.
